name: Bhavinkumar Nakrani
headline: I build AI-powered products and the dependable platforms underneath them.
positioning: Technical Project Manager and senior full-stack engineer with 16+ years of shipping ERP systems, booking platforms, SaaS products and AI agents for clients across Europe, the UK, Asia and the USA.
summary: I'm a hands-on Technical Project Manager and senior full-stack engineer based in Ahmedabad, India. For 16+ years I've built products for clients and employers across Germany, the UK, Denmark, Thailand and India — from municipal portals and real-estate networks to ERP systems used on three continents.

My core is PHP (Symfony, Laravel) and Python, backed by AWS, DevOps and solid database design. Lately my focus is applied AI: LLM-powered agents, RAG pipelines, OCR and prompt engineering wired into real business workflows.

Today I lead a team of 10–13 people, yet around 80% of my day is still hands-on development. I'm a contributor to the Symfony framework and I enjoy turning ambiguous requirements into systems that stay maintainable for years.
